title: calamus sumatranus
intro: Calamus sumatranus, commonly known as Sumatran sweet flag, is a plant species belonging to the family Zingiberaceae. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Calamus sumatranus include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce nausea, and alleviate stress due to its sedative properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include sesquiterpenes, phenolic compounds, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
